All tests pass! ✓

The issue was in line 24 of `invoicing/money.py`. The condition `while len(head) > 3:` was incorrect for Indian digit grouping. Changing it to `while len(head) > 2:` ensures that digits are properly grouped in pairs from the right, with up to 3 digits in the rightmost group.

This fix now correctly formats 12345678 paise as `₹1,23,456.78` instead of the incorrect `₹123,456.78`.
